story.iWant: my recording to stop cleanly and automatically appear in my timeline
story.soThat: I can immediately begin editing without manual import
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create persistent Stop Recording button - Task 2: Implement stop-recording IPC channel - Task 3: Move file save responsibility to main process - Task 4: Implement codec detection and optimization - Task 5: Generate thumbnails for recorded clips - Task 6: Auto-import to media library - Task 7: Auto-add to timeline - Task 8: Display success notification - Task 9: Clean up recording state - Task 10: Implement auto-cleanup of old recordings - Task 11: Handle edge cases and error scenarios - Task 12: Implement stop-recording IPC channel - Task 13: Implement recording-tick IPC event - Task 14: NFR Validation - Task 15: Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. "Stop Recording" button accessible during any recording mode 2. Clicking Stop ends recording immediately and saves files 3. Recording files processed and optimized for editing (codec conversion if needed) 4. Completed recording(s) automatically added to media library with thumbnails 5. For PiP recordings, both clips automatically placed on correct timeline tracks 6. Recording files stored in organized temp directory structure 7. User sees success notification with recording duration

docs.doc: Main process handles file save (architecture change). IPC returns IPCResponse with {filePaths: string[]}. RecordingState.outputFiles array stores completed file paths. NFR: stop-recording completes within 2 seconds.
Main process emits recording-tick every second with {duration: number} payload. Renderer updates recordingStore.recordingDuration for display in Stop button.

artifact.reason: Must implement recording file save with organized directory structure (date-based folders).
Must generate thumbnails from first frame of recorded videos.
Receives auto-imported recordings with metadata and thumbnails.
Auto-adds recordings to Track 1 (single) or Track 1+2 (PiP) at timeline end.

native.api: File save operations in main process

story-context.constraints: - ARCHITECTURE CHANGE: Main process handles all file save operations - Renderer sends blob data via stop-recording IPC - Main returns filePaths array in IPCResponse - Directory structure: os.tmpdir()/chop-shop/recordings/YYYY-MM-DD/ - RecordingState.outputFiles stores completed file paths - Auto-cleanup: delete recordings older than 7 days, keep last 20 - Auto-import: screen → Track 1, webcam → Track 2 (PiP mode) - Stop button: floating, top-right, shows "Recording: HH:MM:SS" - Keyboard shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R to stop

interfaces.interface: Request: { blob: Blob, mode: RecordingMode, timestamp: string } Response: IPCResponse<{ filePaths: string[] }>
Payload: { duration: number } Emitted every second during recording

tests.standards: Jest for unit tests. Manual integration testing for stop IPC, file save, auto-import workflow, codec conversion.
tests.locations: src/main/services/__tests__/ Manual testing: stop recording, file save, auto-import, notifications
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify Stop button visible during recording - AC2: Manual test clicking Stop saves files - AC3: Manual test codec conversion (WebM → MP4 if needed) - AC4: Manual verify thumbnails generated and displayed - AC5: Manual test PiP stop creates 2 files, both auto-imported to Track 1+2 - AC6: Manual verify date-based directory organization - AC7: Manual verify success notification displays with duration - Unit test stop-recording IPC handler - Unit test outputFiles array population - Edge case: Disk full during save shows error
